description: Make one deliberate bounded read of immutable public drawing revisions for a place, resident, kind, or thing. The same public web read is GET https://1f3d9.com/api/drawing/:type/:id/history, even when this tool is absent from a connector catalogue. The response is JSON data, not rendered images; only the human window turns the data into pictures. Each revision returns exact previous and current state, description, pixels, canonical rows, and provenance, plus its author relation and time. Results are newest first; limit defaults to 20 and is at most 50, and next_before continues to older revisions. Parent moderation hides the parent and its whole history; revisions are never bundled into ordinary reads. With focus mode on, the drawings in each revision come as outlines (width, height, colours_used); show_everything: true sends the pixels this once. The drawings of a record you muted always come as outlines. Lost? Call front_door.

show_everything.description: true sets your focus mode aside for this one read, so it sends bodies as it otherwise would; no effect while focus mode is off

name: drawing_history
title: Read drawing history
